entries.prompt: The attached official PHG 2021 screenshot shows SIX detached masks in one horizontal row. Isolate ONLY mask number 1 counting from image-LEFT to image-RIGHT (row1,column1). Ignore all five other masks. This exact positional screenshot edition is the identity: do not assign an invented catalogue cosmetic name. Preserve its actual near-frontal source camera, slight asymmetry, projected proportions and contour. Keep the broad smooth dark metallic rounded crown, curved panel boundaries, existing side module and tiny physical red lenses, existing patterned pale/silver eye inserts, and tapered long central lower plate with its two narrow vertical lower edge details. Most importantly preserve the precise source-visible damage pattern of THIS column: The long rough diagonal slash runs from high image-left forehead toward the lower image-right brow/cheek; preserve its existing split, ragged raised edges and smaller adjacent cuts. Do not average the six masks, combine their injuries, beautify away damage or create new scars, runes, glyphs, vents, horns or hardware. Keep actual source bluish dark gunmetal/silver palette and local game lighting; scratches are physical surface wear, not new colored paint. Do not recover hidden side/back or imaginary intact shapes behind damage. Exactly one complete isolated rigid mask on genuine transparent RGBA, 10 percent clear transparent margin on all sides, crown and chin entirely visible, longest axis at78-80percent canvas. No other masks, background, purple scene glow, floor, shadow plane, text, logo, UI, wearer tissue, hair/dreadlocks, neck or body. A is a new source-view isolation faithful to this screenshot, not a new mesh or certified exact game file; fine damage relief remains limited by roughly200x280source pixels.
